title: Desk Card: Patient Payment Plans Add-On Terms by Tier
content:
Whether new charges may be added to a Patient Payment Plans plan after signing, and within what limits, is set tier by tier.

| Tier | Add-ons permitted after signing | Maximum add-ons over the plan's life | Add-on method recorded for the tier | Installments that must still remain for an add-on | Smallest total of charges accepted as one add-on (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | No | 0 | Re-spread over the remaining term | 0 | 25.00 |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | Yes | 2 | Re-spread over the remaining term | 2 | 25.00 |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | Yes | 3 | Re-spread over the remaining term | 3 | 25.00 |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | Yes | 3 | Re-spread over the remaining term | 3 | 25.00 |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | Yes | 3 | Re-spread over the remaining term | 3 | 25.00 |
| Financial Hardship Plan | Yes | 4 | Restart the term | 3 | 25.00 |

**About the add-on method column.** The column records the add-on method set for each tier. The clause under which a tier recorded as re-spreading over the remaining term re-spreads the remaining balance over the installments left with the same end date, and a tier recorded as restarting the term spreads it over a fresh full term from the next due date, is **no longer in force**. How the balance is spread after an add-on, and whether the term is lengthened with it, follow the current basis for re-spreading the installment and for lengthening the term after an add-on; the column does not state that basis.

**Card notes.**

- The 3-Month Interest-Free Plan permits no add-on; its maximum of 0 and its minimum-remaining figure of 0 reflect that.
- The Financial Hardship Plan permits the most add-ons, 4, and its add-ons restart the term.
- The smallest add-on accepted is 25.00 on every tier.
